name: Data-Dependent Normal Vector Quantizer (Simulated Annealing)
definition: An iterative optimization method to generate normal vector quantizers that are dependent on the specific volume data being rendered, aiming to improve image quality over static quantizers.
summary: This method uses simulated annealing to generate a data-dependent normal vector quantizer optimized for specific volume datasets, differing from static approaches by allowing variable vector counts to improve shading quality.
